entities.name: Large ribosomal subunit protein uL23
observations: Exact 111-aa query sequence matches reviewed UniProt Q82X86 from Nitrosomonas europaea (100% identity and coverage).
uL23 binds 23S rRNA, contributes to the outer surface of the ribosomal polypeptide exit tunnel, and provides a major docking site for trigger factor.
Sequence-derived properties: 12,910.8 Da estimated molecular mass; theoretical pI 9.95; predicted charge at pH 7 +9.51; GRAVY −0.612.
Pfam Ribosomal_L23 domain (PF00276.26) detected at residues 13–102 (i-Evalue 4.1e-28).
